bullets.text: Copilot's Text Interaction - **Microsoft** Copilot now supports text-based interactions, enhancing user experience for Windows Insiders.
Empowering AI Innovation - **Microsoft** drives AI transformation, helping customers unlock creativity and solve significant challenges.
Strengthened OpenAI Partnership - **Microsoft** and **OpenAI** deepen collaboration, enhancing AI innovation and exclusive rights.
AI-Powered Paint Feature - New **Paint** update introduces Restyle, allowing users to transform image styles with AI.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - **Microsoft** releases new Insider builds, enhancing features like Copy & Search and Voice Typing.
AI in Edge Browsing - **Microsoft Edge** introduces Copilot Mode, transforming browsing into an interactive AI experience.
Identity Security Focus - **Microsoft** emphasizes identity defense amidst rising cyber threats, enhancing protection strategies.
